about: SHA-256 of Apple's ADI libraries inside the Apple Music APK, by x-apple-version-number and ABI (SIGN 7.5). Hashes only: the libraries are fetched from Apple's CDN at runtime after consent and never redistributed. A version missing here is trusted on first use and recorded locally; a Russet release adds it. 4.9.6.1447/x86_64 was recorded by W22 on 2026-10-31 (provenance in docs/windows/W22-STATUS.md).
